title: Driving Tests in China
synopsis: Do you know how to get a driving licence in China?

fullText.simplified:
在中国怎么考驾照

    很多朋友很好奇：在中国怎么考驾照？
    一般在中国，人们要考驾照，首先会选择一个驾校。之后的报名、考试等，由驾校帮忙预约。简单地说，要拿到驾照分五步。
    第一步，报名体检。体检合格后，才能进行后面的各种考试。
    第二步，科目一考试。科目一又称驾驶员理论考试。考试内容包括驾车理论基础、道路安全法律法规、地方性法规等相关知识。考试形式为上机考试，100道题，90分及以上过关。
    第三步，科目二考试。通过了科目一考试后，便是科目二。科目二是驾照考试中的难点，主要包括：倒车入库、坡道定点停车与起步等。
    第四步，科目三考试。科目二考试合格后，等待学员的就是科目三——大路考。考试项目有：灯光模拟考试、上车准备、起步、变更车道、超车、通过路口，通过人行横道、通过学校区域、通过公共汽车站、路口转弯等。路考是在车管所规定的真实道路上考的，而这段路并不是考试专用的，跟普通的公共道路一样，平时有非考试的车来往，所以路考除了考学员的驾车技巧，还考学员随机应变的能力。
    第五步，安全文明常识考试，俗称“科目四”。这个是近年来新增加的考试内容，主要考的是“车德”。考试试卷由50道题组成，题目以案例、图片、动画等形式为主。和科目一一样，满分100分，90分合格。
    经过了这五步，你就可以拿到中国驾照了。当然，如果你在中国长期居住，而且有外国驾照的话，可以去车管所申请把外国驾照换成中国驾照。在这种情况下，你就不用考那么多个考试了，只用考科目一，只要科目一过关，你就可以拿到中国驾照了。现在很多地方的科目一考试都有英文版的，外国朋友不再需要担心因为语言不过关而不能拿到驾照了。
fullText.traditional:
在中國怎麼考駕照

    很多朋友很好奇：在中國怎麼考駕照？
    一般在中國，人們要考駕照，首先會選擇一個駕校。之後的報名、考試等，由駕校幫忙預約。簡單地說，要拿到駕照分五步。
    第一步，報名體檢。體檢合格後，才能進行後面的各種考試。
    第二步，科目一考試。科目一又稱駕駛員理論考試。考試內容包括駕車理論基礎、道路安全法律法規、地方性法規等相關知識。考試形式為上機考試，100道題，90分及以上過關。
    第三步，科目二考試。通過了科目一考試後，便是科目二。科目二是駕照考試中的難點，主要包括：倒車入庫、坡道定點停車與起步等。
    第四步，科目三考試。科目二考試合格後，等待學員的就是科目三——大路考。考試項目有：燈光模擬考試、上車準備、起步、變更車道、超車、通過路口，通過人行橫道、通過學校區域、通過公共汽車站、路口轉彎等。路考是在車管所規定的真實道路上考的，而這段路並不是考試專用的，跟普通的公共道路一樣，平時有非考試的車來往，所以路考除了考學員的駕車技巧，還考學員隨機應變的能力。
    第五步，安全文明常識考試，俗稱“科目四”。這個是近年來新增加的考試內容，主要考的是“車德”。考試試卷由50道題組成，題目以案例、圖片、動畫等形式為主。和科目一一樣，滿分100分，90分合格。
    經過了這五步，你就可以拿到中國駕照了。當然，如果你在中國長期居住，而且有外國駕照的話，可以去車管所申請把外國駕照換成中國駕照。在這種情況下，你就不用考那麼多個考試了，只用考科目一，只要科目一過關，你就可以拿到中國駕照了。現在很多地方的科目一考試都有英文版的，外國朋友不再需要擔心因為語言不過關而不能拿到駕照了。

sentences.english: A lot of people are curious: how do you take the driving test in China?

sentences.simplified: 一般在中国，人们要考驾照，首先会选择一个驾校。
sentences.traditional: 一般在中國，人們要考駕照，首先會選擇一個駕校。
sentences.pinyin: yì bān zài zhōng guó rén men yào kǎo jià zhào shǒu xiān huì xuǎn zé yí ge jià xiào

sentences.simplified: 之后的报名、考试等，由驾校帮忙预约。
sentences.traditional: 之後的報名、考試等，由駕校幫忙預約。
sentences.pinyin: zhī hòu de bào míng kǎo shì děng yóu jià xiào bāng máng yù yuē
sentences.english: Generally, in China people who want to take the driving test first select a driving school.

sentences.simplified: 简单地说，要拿到驾照分五步。
sentences.traditional: 簡單地說，要拿到駕照分五步。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎn dān de shuō yào ná dào jià zhào fēn wǔ bù
sentences.english: The subsequent registration, tests, and so on are arranged with the help of the driving school.
To put it simply, there are five steps to get a driver’s license.

sentences.simplified: 第一步，报名体检。
sentences.traditional: 第一步，報名體檢。
sentences.pinyin: dì yī bù bào míng tǐ jiǎn

sentences.simplified: 体检合格后，才能进行后面的各种考试。
sentences.traditional: 體檢合格後，才能進行後面的各種考試。
sentences.pinyin: tǐ jiǎn hé gé hòu cái néng jìn xíng hòu miàn de gè zhǒng kǎo shì
sentences.english: The first step is to apply for a physical examination.
Only after the requirements of the physical examination are met are you able to register for the subsequent examinations.

sentences.simplified: 第二步，科目一考试。
sentences.traditional: 第二步，科目一考試。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr bù kē mù yī kǎo shì

sentences.simplified: 科目一又称驾驶员理论考试。
sentences.traditional: 科目一又稱駕駛員理論考試。
sentences.pinyin: kē mù yī yòu chēng jià shǐ yuán lǐ lùn kǎo shì
sentences.english: The second step is the Subject 1 Examination.

sentences.simplified: 考试内容包括驾车理论基础、道路安全法律法规、地方性法规等相关知识。
sentences.traditional: 考試內容包括駕車理論基礎、道路安全法律法規、地方性法規等相關知識。
sentences.pinyin: kǎo shì nèi róng bāo kuò jià chē lǐ lùn jī chǔ dào lù ān quán fǎ lǜ fǎ guī dì fāng xìng fǎ guī děng xiāng guān zhī shi
sentences.english: The Subject 1 Examination is also called the Driving Theory Examination.

sentences.simplified: 考试形式为上机考试，100道题，90分及以上过关。
sentences.traditional: 考試形式為上機考試，100道題，90分及以上過關。
sentences.pinyin: kǎo shì xíng shì wéi shàng jī kǎo shì 2 dào tí 2 fēn jí yǐ shàng guò guān
sentences.english: The examination consists of relevant knowledge such as basic driving theory, road safety laws and regulations, and local regulations.
The examination is conducted by computer. There are 100 questions, with a passing score of 90 or above.

sentences.simplified: 第三步，科目二考试。
sentences.traditional: 第三步，科目二考試。
sentences.pinyin: dì sān bù kē mù èr kǎo shì

sentences.simplified: 通过了科目一考试后，便是科目二。
sentences.traditional: 通過了科目一考試後，便是科目二。
sentences.pinyin: tōng guò le kē mù yī kǎo shì hòu biàn shì kē mù èr
sentences.english: The third step is the Subject 2 Examination.

sentences.simplified: 科目二是驾照考试中的难点，主要包括：
sentences.traditional: 科目二是駕照考試中的難點，主要包括：
sentences.pinyin: kē mù èr shì jià zhào kǎo shì zhōng de nán diǎn zhǔ yào bāo kuò
sentences.english: The Subject 2 Examination comes after passing the Subject 1 Examination.

sentences.simplified: 倒车入库、坡道定点停车与起步等。
sentences.traditional: 倒車入庫、坡道定點停車與起步等。
sentences.pinyin: dào chē rù kù pō dào dìng diǎn tíng chē yǔ qǐ bù děng
sentences.english: The Subject 2 Examination is the difficult part of the driving test, and most importantly includes: ..
.. reversing into a garage, stopping and starting from a designated point on a slope etc.

sentences.simplified: 第四步，科目三考试。
sentences.traditional: 第四步，科目三考試。
sentences.pinyin: dì sì bù kē mù sān kǎo shì

sentences.simplified: 科目二考试合格后，等待学员的就是科目三——大路考。
sentences.traditional: 科目二考試合格後，等待學員的就是科目三——大路考。
sentences.pinyin: kē mù èr kǎo shì hé gé hòu děng dài xué yuán de jiù shì kē mù sān dà lù kǎo
sentences.english: The fourth step, is the Subject 3 Examination.

sentences.simplified: 考试项目有：灯光模拟考试、上车准备、起步、变更车道、
sentences.traditional: 考試項目有：燈光模擬考試、上車準備、起步、變更車道、
sentences.pinyin: kǎo shì xiàng mù yǒu dēng guāng mó nǐ kǎo shì shàng chē zhǔn bèi qǐ bù biàn gēng chē dào
sentences.english: After passing the Subject 2 Examination, students go onto the Subject 3 Examination — the highway test.

sentences.simplified: 超车、通过路口，通过人行横道、通过学校区域、
sentences.traditional: 超車、通過路口，通過人行橫道、通過學校區域、
sentences.pinyin: chāo chē tōng guò lù kǒu tōng guò rén xíng héng dào tōng guò xué xiào qū yù
sentences.english: The examination includes: lighting simulation test, preparation before driving, starting, changing lanes, ..

sentences.simplified: 通过公共汽车站、路口转弯等。
sentences.traditional: 通過公共汽車站、路口轉彎等。
sentences.pinyin: tōng guò gōng gòng qì chē zhàn lù kǒu zhuǎn wān děng
sentences.english: ..  overtaking another vehicle, passing an intersection, passing a pedestrian crossing, passing a school area, ..

sentences.simplified: 路考是在车管所规定的真实道路上考的，
sentences.traditional: 路考是在車管所規定的真實道路上考的，
sentences.pinyin: lù kǎo shì zài chē guǎn suǒ guī dìng de zhēn shí dào lù shang kǎo de
sentences.english: .. passing a bus stop, and turning at an intersection etc.

sentences.simplified: 而这段路并不是考试专用的，
sentences.traditional: 而這段路並不是考試專用的，
sentences.pinyin: ér zhè duàn lù bìng bú shì kǎo shì zhuān yòng de
sentences.english: The highway test is taken on real roads regulated by the vehicle administration office.

sentences.simplified: 跟普通的公共道路一样，平时有非考试的车来往，
sentences.traditional: 跟普通的公共道路一樣，平時有非考試的車來往，
sentences.pinyin: gēn pǔ tōng de gōng gòng dào lù yí yàng píng shí yǒu fēi kǎo shì de chē lái wǎng
sentences.english: The roads aren’t just for taking the exam test.

sentences.simplified: 所以路考除了考学员的驾车技巧，还考学员随机应变的能力。
sentences.traditional: 所以路考除了考學員的駕車技巧，還考學員隨機應變的能力。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ lù kǎo chú le kǎo xué yuán de jià chē jì qiǎo hái kǎo xué yuán suí jī yìng biàn de néng lì
sentences.english: They are ordinary public roads, and there are cars that are not taking the test on the road.
Therefore, apart from testing driving skills, the highway test also tests the student’s ability to adapt according to the situation.

sentences.simplified: 第五步，安全文明常识考试，俗称“科目四”。
sentences.traditional: 第五步，安全文明常識考試，俗稱“科目四”。
sentences.pinyin: dì wǔ bù ān quán wén míng cháng shí kǎo shì sú chēng kē mù sì

sentences.simplified: 这个是近年来新增加的考试内容，主要考的是“车德”。
sentences.traditional: 這個是近年來新增加的考試內容，主要考的是“車德”。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shì jìn nián lái xīn zēng jiā de kǎo shì nèi róng zhǔ yào kǎo de shì chē dé
sentences.english: The fifth step is the safety and civilization “common sense” examination, commonly known as the “Subject 4 Examination.”

sentences.simplified: 考试试卷由50道题组成，题目以案例、图片、动画等形式为主。
sentences.traditional: 考試試卷由50道題組成，題目以案例、圖片、動畫等形式為主。
sentences.pinyin: kǎo shì shì juàn yóu 2 dào tí zǔ chéng tí mù yǐ àn lì tú piàn dòng huà děng xíng shì wéi zhǔ
sentences.english: This is a new addition in recent years to the examination. It mainly tests “driving ethics.”

sentences.simplified: 和科目一一样，满分100分，90分合格。
sentences.traditional: 和科目一一樣，滿分100分，90分合格。
sentences.pinyin: hé kē mù yī yí yàng mǎn fēn 2 fēn 2 fēn hé gé
sentences.english: The Examination contains 50 questions, mainly legal cases, photographs, and animations etc,
As with Examination 1, the maximum score is 100 and the passing score is 90.

sentences.simplified: 经过了这五步，你就可以拿到中国驾照了。
sentences.traditional: 經過了這五步，你就可以拿到中國駕照了。
sentences.pinyin: jīng guò le zhè wǔ bù nǐ jiù kě yǐ ná dào zhōng guó jià zhào le

sentences.simplified: 当然，如果你在中国长期居住，而且有外国驾照的话，
sentences.traditional: 當然，如果你在中國長期居住，而且有外國駕照的話，
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán rú guǒ nǐ zài zhōng guó cháng qī jū zhù ér qiě yǒu wài guó jià zhào de huà
sentences.english: Having passed this fifth step, you can get a Chinese driver’s license.

sentences.simplified: 可以去车管所申请把外国驾照换成中国驾照。
sentences.traditional: 可以去車管所申請把外國駕照換成中國駕照。
sentences.pinyin: kě yǐ qù chē guǎn suǒ shēn qǐng bǎ wài guó jià zhào huàn chéng zhōng guó jià zhào
sentences.english: Of course, if you reside in China long term and also have a foreign driver’s license, ..

sentences.simplified: 在这种情况下，你就不用考那么多个考试了，只用考科目一，
sentences.traditional: 在這種情況下，你就不用考那麼多個考試了，只用考科目一，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè zhǒng qíng kuàng xià nǐ jiù bú yòng kǎo nà me duō ge kǎo shì le zhǐ yòng kǎo kē mù yī
sentences.english: .. you can go to the vehicle administration office to apply to get your foreign driver’s license converted to a Chinese driver’s license.

sentences.simplified: 只要科目一过关，你就可以拿到中国驾照了。
sentences.traditional: 只要科目一過關，你就可以拿到中國駕照了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào kē mù yī guò guān nǐ jiù kě yǐ ná dào zhōng guó jià zhào le
sentences.english: In this case, you don’t have to take so many exams; you only have to take the Subject 1 Examination.

sentences.simplified: 现在很多地方的科目一考试都有英文版的，
sentences.traditional: 現在很多地方的科目一考試都有英文版的，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài hěn duō dì fang de kē mù yī kǎo shì dōu yǒu yīng wén bǎn de
sentences.english: As long as you pass Subject 1 Examination, you can get a Chinese driver’s license.

sentences.simplified: 外国朋友不再需要担心因为语言不过关而不能拿到驾照了。
sentences.traditional: 外國朋友不再需要擔心因為語言不過關而不能拿到駕照了。
sentences.pinyin: wài guó péng you bú zài xū yào dān xīn yīn wèi yǔ yán bú guò guān ér bù néng ná dào jià zhào le
sentences.english: Many places now have English version of the Subject 1 Examination.
Foreigners don’t have to worry about failing due to the language and being unable to get a driver’s licence.

sentence_translations: How do you take the driving test in China?
A lot of people are curious: how do you take the driving test in China?
Generally, in China people who want to take the driving test first select a driving school.
The subsequent registration, tests, and so on are arranged with the help of the driving school.
To put it simply, there are five steps to get a driver’s license.
The first step is to apply for a physical examination.
Only after the requirements of the physical examination are met are you able to register for the subsequent examinations.
The second step is the Subject 1 Examination.
The Subject 1 Examination is also called the Driving Theory Examination.
The examination consists of relevant knowledge such as basic driving theory, road safety laws and regulations, and local regulations.
The examination is conducted by computer. There are 100 questions, with a passing score of 90 or above.
The third step is the Subject 2 Examination.
The Subject 2 Examination comes after passing the Subject 1 Examination.
The Subject 2 Examination is the difficult part of the driving test, and most importantly includes: ..
.. reversing into a garage, stopping and starting from a designated point on a slope etc.
The fourth step, is the Subject 3 Examination.
After passing the Subject 2 Examination, students go onto the Subject 3 Examination — the highway test.
The examination includes: lighting simulation test, preparation before driving, starting, changing lanes, ..
..  overtaking another vehicle, passing an intersection, passing a pedestrian crossing, passing a school area, ..
.. passing a bus stop, and turning at an intersection etc.
The highway test is taken on real roads regulated by the vehicle administration office.
The roads aren’t just for taking the exam test.
They are ordinary public roads, and there are cars that are not taking the test on the road.
Therefore, apart from testing driving skills, the highway test also tests the student’s ability to adapt according to the situation.
The fifth step is the safety and civilization “common sense” examination, commonly known as the “Subject 4 Examination.”
This is a new addition in recent years to the examination. It mainly tests “driving ethics.”
The Examination contains 50 questions, mainly legal cases, photographs, and animations etc,
As with Examination 1, the maximum score is 100 and the passing score is 90.
Having passed this fifth step, you can get a Chinese driver’s license.
Of course, if you reside in China long term and also have a foreign driver’s license, ..
.. you can go to the vehicle administration office to apply to get your foreign driver’s license converted to a Chinese driver’s license.
In this case, you don’t have to take so many exams; you only have to take the Subject 1 Examination.
As long as you pass Subject 1 Examination, you can get a Chinese driver’s license.
Many places now have English version of the Subject 1 Examination.
Foreigners don’t have to worry about failing due to the language and being unable to get a driver’s licence.
